detailsSections.heading: Overview
detailsSections.text: Elan The Emperor is an ultra-luxury residential project located in Sector 106, Dwarka Expressway, Gurugram. Developed by Elan Group, this iconic development offers world-class 4 & 5 BHK residences designed for premium living and exclusivity. This project is positioned as one of the most prestigious addresses on Dwarka Expressway, combining luxury, connectivity, and modern architecture.

detailsSections.heading: Key Highlights
detailsSections.text:
• Ultra-luxury 4 & 5 BHK apartments & penthouses
• Located on Dwarka Expressway (Sector 106 Gurgaon)
• Private lift lobby & elevators for each residence
• Massive clubhouse with 100+ amenities
• Green-facing and club-facing premium units
• High-rise towers with smart home features
• Resort-style living with landscaped greens

detailsSections.heading: Location Advantages
detailsSections.text:
Direct access to Dwarka Expressway
15 mins to IGI Airport
20 mins to Cyber City & Udyog Vihar
Close to top schools, hospitals & malls
Excellent connectivity to Delhi & Gurgaon
